title: Save and load individual patches
summary: Toolkit uses an undocumented SysEx protocol to read and write patches over USB without booting the synth into backup mode.
alt: Individual JD-08 patch slots laid out in the Memory tab

title: 43 extra waveforms
summary: Choose from the synth’s hidden waveforms: strings, brass, grand pianos and guitars. Save and load them into any JD-08.
alt: The wave browser open at 131, Grand mf A, with more piano waves and a nylon guitar below it

title: Two-way panel editing
summary: Move the JD-08’s faders and the editor follows. Drag a control in Toolkit and hear the change mirrored live to the synth.
alt: The editor showing the waveform, tuning and filter settings for all four tones side by side

title: A mod matrix per tone
summary: Use the mod lever to speed up an LFO or lengthen the filter attack. Each tone has four source slots with four destinations apiece.
alt: Tone A’s modulation matrix with separate depths for the modulation lever, aftertouch and velocity

title: Unison voices and detune
summary: JD-08’s hardware unison control is limited to an on/off switch. Toolkit lets you choose the specific voice count and detune.
alt: Unison switched on with Voices set to 6 and Detune set to 20

title: Two parts, 64 steps
summary: Draw notes, velocity and motion in the JD-08’s sequencer. Save patterns alongside the patches that play them.
alt: Part A’s notes highlighted in the piano roll, with a velocity lane below

title: Both effects groups
summary: Toolkit is the only JD-08 editor we found that lets you reorder effects and edit all 54 parameters, from distortion drive to reverb type.
alt: Effects A with routing, distortion, spectrum and enhancer controls
